_source: Layouts/paths verified against PokEditor-Core (formats/pokemon_sprites/PokemonSpriteParser + gamedata/GameFiles) and the retail ROMs. Cipher directions follow DSPRE SpriteScrambling.
title: Pokémon Platinum

/poketool/pokegra/pl_pokegra.narc.comment: 494 species × 6 files: femaleBack, maleBack, femaleFront, maleFront, palette, shinyPalette. Each NCGR is 160×80 = two 80×80 idle-animation frames (correct, not doubled). Pt/HG/SS scan front-to-back, which the decoder already does — no render fix needed here.

/poketool/icongra/pl_poke_icon.narc.comment: 7 leading files, then one 32×32 4bpp icon per species; palettes shared via an arm9 table.

/poketool/trgra/trfgra.narc.comment: Five files per class. File 4, the scan, is ciphered front-to-back.

/poketool/trgra/trbgra.narc.comment: Five files per class. File 4, the scan, is ciphered front-to-back.
